label: kadoukanouchini
title_raw: かどうかのうちに [かどうかのうちに] (kadoukanouchini)
title: かどうかのうちに

examples.japanese: 電車のドアが開いたかどうかのうちに
examples.body_text:
電車のドアが開いたかどうかのうちに 

Before you know 
		if the train doors opened or not.
examples.body_html:
電車のドアが開いたかどうかのうちに 
Before you know if the train doors opened or not.

examples.japanese: 授業ベルが鳴らすかどうか教室から学生が出ました。
examples.body_text:
授業ベルが鳴らすかどうか教室から学生が出ました。 

Just as the school bell rang, 
		the students dashed out of the classroom.
examples.body_html:
授業ベルが鳴らすかどうか教室から学生が出ました。 
Just as the school bell rang, the students dashed out of the classroom.

comments.text: this is almost as if the user is not sure the new state has occurred yet.. did the doors open ("ka dou ka") or not yet..
comments.html: this is almost as if the user is not sure the new state has occurred yet.. did the doors open ("ka dou ka") or not yet..

comments.text: Literally, it means "while it is not certain whether the door opened or not," so you cannot tell if the door opened or not. It depends upon the text that follows, but normally, it would mean that the door did open.

# 授業（終了の）ベルが鳴るかどうかのうちに　is better. 

I would say from the English...

授業終了のベルが鳴るか鳴らないかのうちに、学生たちは教室から飛び出しました。  This does not mean students flew out, by the way.
